blurb: They operate two beachfront retail and rental locations on San Francisco Bay: a beginner-friendly site at Crown Beach in Alameda and an intermediate to advanced site at Coyote Point in San Mateo. Their team includes experienced instructors and gear specialists who provide personalized guidance for learning and progressing in various boardsports. They offer lessons, rentals, demos, and retail sales of equipment and accessories.
